snippet.title: RentPoly - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4236430/RentPoly/

Take a look at the Announcement Trailer for RentPoly, a new roguelike real-estate board game developed by Sunpeak Games. Build your own real estate empire, collect rent from tenants, and work your way toward becoming a billionaire.

RentPoly is scheduled to release in 2026.
